With CoLab, they don’t have to be.
AutoReview, CoLab’s AI Peer Checker, runs a first pass check
AutoReview is an AI Peer Checker trained on your design standards and guidelines, lessons learned, and industry best practices. It annotates drawings and 3D models to identify errors and non-conformances, so you can bring a cleaner design to your first SME review.
Run virtual design reviews, so SMEs can flag risks earlier
Use CoLab to make CAD accessible in the browser, so anyone can explore the model and add feedback — without needing special tools or training. In live reviews, engineers see each other’s comments appear in real time, sparking better ideas and discussions.
Track and organize knowledge as a byproduct of reviews (not an extra step)
Feedback in CoLab is automatically saved with full design context and pulled into a structured database — so it’s easy to search, filter, and act on. You can also bring in data from PLM, ERP, and past reviews to create a single source of design knowledge across your tools.
Deploy AI agents trained on your organization's collective knowledge
With your product data and knowledge data together in one place for the first time, you can deploy agents that assist engineers at any phase of a program. CoLab’s first out-of-the-box agent finds similar designs and surfaces insights from past reviews on those designs, automating the traditional lessons learned process.
Connecting CoLab with PLM and CAD is fast, easy, and secure.
CoLab integrates with major PLM systems, including Windchill, Teamcenter, and 3DXPERIENCE. You can share CAD directly to CoLab from your PLM, maintaining critical data associations. Because CoLab accepts 30+ file types, it’s easy to review native CAD, even if you’re working with a supplier or customer that uses a different CAD tool.
